title: Constellation background starfield that links won bouts into glowing zodiac geometries behind the lattice, plus a slow-motion harmonic shatter finale when a Championship Series is clinched.
summary: Generate a dynamic background astral starfield that connects won series vectors into luminous zodiac constellations and detonates into slow-motion shards upon series clinch.
technical_specification: Maintain `state.world.constellationNodes` containing completed bout vector nodes `(x, y)` in observatory space. On every bout win, connect nodes using Catmull-Rom or linear interpolation with alpha pulsed by `Math.sin(state.world.time * 0.003) * 0.3 + 0.7`. Upon series clinch (`state.stats.seriesOver && state.stats.wins > state.stats.losses`), set `state.world.timeDilation = 0.25` for 180 frames and spawn 60 prismatic glass fragments in `state.world.shatterParticles` with velocity `v = (Math.random() * 4 + 2)` along radial angle `θ = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2` and angular spin `ω = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1`.
acceptance_criteria: Completed winning triads permanently append luminous connective constellation edges in the background layer.
Series clinch triggers a 0.25x slow-motion visual dilation paired with expanding prismatic shard particles.
Particles decay and clear automatically when SERIES_RESET is dispatched.
